messages:
Alex Chen: Heads-up — we've been seeing a spike in onboarding playbook triggers from the same subset of accounts. many are false positives from legacy integration flags. thinking we should quarantine that signal and run a dry-run correction before changing playbook rules. anyone else seeing this?
Priya Sharma: yup noticed it this morning. flagged ~120 accounts where onboarding steps never actually completed but playbooks kept nudging. :face_with_raised_eyebrow:
Jordan Lee: do we have a quick query to surface the top offending flags? can run a sample and confirm.
Alex Chen: here's the rough query i used in the sandbox:```sql
SELECT account_id, flag_source, created_at FROM onboarding_signals
WHERE flag_type = 'integration_missing' AND created_at > now() - interval '30 days'
ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 500;
```
Maya Patel: thanks alex. looks like 70% of those are from the old webhook v1 that our sync job stopped handling last quarter. playbook rules didn't account for webhook_version.
Priya Sharma: proposal: add a quarantine tag `onboard:quarantine_v1` that suppresses automatic nudges, run playbook-bot in dry-run for 2 days on a random 10% sample, then reconcile. thoughts?
Jordan Lee: +1 on sampling. can we also add a healthscore bucket check so quarantined accounts don't artificially pull down trial cohorts? e.g., exclude from "onboard_active" bucket while in quarantine.
Alex Chen: agree. config snippet i suggest for playbook-bot:```yaml
quarantine_rules:
  - condition: flag_source = 'webhook_v1'
    actions: [suppress_nudge, add_tag:onboard:quarantine_v1]
    sample_rate: 0.1  # dry-run first
```
Sam (playbook-bot): automatic note: dry-run enabled for rule set `quarantine_rules` at 10% sample. Will emit telemetry to channel `cs-telemetry` and tag events with `dryrun=true`.
Maya Patel: also we should adjust health scoring logic for a temporary window: treat `integration_missing` from webhook_v1 as low-confidence and subtract 0.1 from score rather than full penalty. less churn in renewal risk signals.
Priya Sharma: can we add a quick dashboard tile: "quarantine sample — % nudges suppressed / false positive rate"? PMs will want to see impact.
Jordan Lee: i'll wire a Grafana panel — need the event keys from playbook-bot telemetry. @Sam can you confirm the telemetry fields?
Sam (playbook-bot): telemetry schema: event_type, account_id, rule_id, sample_rate, dryrun, action_suggested, timestamp. Will publish to `cs-telemetry` stream.
Alex Chen: action items: 1) Jordan — Grafana panel for suppression metrics (ETA tomorrow) 2) Maya — patch healthscore heuristic to treat webhook_v1 as low-confidence (ETA 2 days) 3) Priya — coordinate dry-run comms with CS leads and set acceptance criteria 4) Jordan/Alex — schedule a 48h dry-run at 10% and reconvene.
Priya Sharma: noted. i'll ping CS leads + add a short runbook doc in Confluence. @Jordan tag me when the panel is up. :thumbsup:
Jordan Lee: will do. ping me if you want the sample exported for manual review.
Maya Patel: thanks team — this should reduce churn in our onboarding nudges and keep renewal signals cleaner.
Priya Sharma: rough deadline: finish dry-run and review by next Thu. closing the loop then.
Alex Chen: thanks all. closing thread for now — i'll open a follow-up after the dry-run completes.
